name: Bonecache Overseer
assumptions: Rendered the `cost:{PayLife<1>}` flag as "Pay 1 life" combined with the tap symbol (`{T}, Pay 1 life:`). The schema doesn't give an explicit template for this flag's syntax, but "Pay N life" is the most literal reading of `PayLife<1>`.

Displayed power/toughness (1/1) alongside the type line, since the self registry supplies them directly and a real card face would show them, even though the output format's numbered list names only "type line" as its own section.
couldNotDerive: No card name (by design of the exercise).
No supertypes or rarity -- the registry and nodes don't specify them, and rarity is explicitly withheld.
notes: Mana cost, type line, P/T, and the tap+pay-1-life-draw-a-card ability itself all reconstruct correctly -- node C (tap, cost:{PayLife<1>}) -> D (emit draw) is a faithful, complete encoding of the ability's cost and effect. The real gap: the ability's entire activation restriction is missing from the node set. Real Forge script: `A:AB$ Draw | Cost$ T PayLife<1> | CheckSVar$ X | SVarCompare$ GE3 | SpellDescription$ Draw a card. Activate only if three or more cards left your graveyard this turn or if you've sacrificed a Food this turn.` with `SVar:X:Count$LeftGraveyardThisTurn Card.YouOwn/Plus.Y` and `SVar:Y:PlayerCountPropertyYou$SacrificedThisTurn Food/Times.3` -- i.e. X = (cards you own that left your graveyard this turn) + (3 if you've sacrificed a Food this turn this turn, else 0), gated by SVarCompare$ GE3. This is an OR of two independent conditions (graveyard-mill-count >= 3, OR sacrificed-a-Food-this-turn) implemented arithmetically: the Food sub-condition is folded in as a flat +3 bonus (via SVar Y's Times.3 multiplier) specifically so it alone pushes X over the GE3 threshold regardless of the graveyard count, rather than as two separately-evaluated branches. Node C carries no `cond:` flag and there is no upstream `sensor`/`scaler` node feeding it, so this whole restriction clause is silently absent from the packet -- the examiner had no way to know it existed and reconstructed an unconditional activated ability. This is a decomposition gap, not a schema gap: SCHEMA.md's `sensor`/`scaler` roles plus a `cond:` payload on the gated node are exactly the vocabulary needed (cf. Beza the Bounding Spring's two-sensor-node treatment of a comparison-based CheckSVar$/SVarCompare$ gate), so the fix belongs in edges.json via REVIEW_PROCESS.md, not in SCHEMA.md. This is the same known unsupported-dynamic-condition class documented on Essence Channeler/Star Charter/Beza (CheckSVar$ + SVarCompare$ gating an ability), but on the `AB$` (activated ability) field variant rather than a trigger or static's `Condition*` fields, and with a narrower additional wrinkle worth flagging separately for forgeTranslate.ts: the OR-via-Count$.../Plus.Y-with-a-Times.N-multiplier idiom (one condition folded into the other's threshold arithmetic as a flat bonus) is a different shape from Beza's two-independent-sensors-plus-compare pattern and would need its own recognition even after generic CheckSVar$/SVarCompare$ support is added.
